_comment: Files allowed to keep raw Tailwind palette classes, opaque bg-white or hex colours (#315, #118). Each entry is the exact number of hits web/src/tests/raw-color-guard.test.js finds today. The count is a ratchet: it may only go down, and the test fails until you lower it here after migrating. Never add a file or raise a count without a reason a reviewer would accept. Everything else must use the design tokens in web/src/index.css (see docs/ui-primitives.md, Design tokens).

src/pages/PortalIntakeForm.jsx.reason: Deliberately dark (slate-950/900) public intake form. It needs a dark-surface token set before it can move to tokens; light tokens would invert it. See portal-text-contrast-guard.test.js.

src/pages/Pipeline.jsx.reason: Categorical pipeline-stage colours (six gradient stage headers plus the invoiced/paid chips). Six categories cannot be expressed with the four status tokens without losing the distinction; each stage also has an icon and a label.

src/pages/Expenses.jsx.reason: Categorical expense-category chips (pink/teal/lime) that have no status meaning. The chip text states the category.

src/pages/BrandSettings.jsx.reason: Default values for the client's own brand colours (<input type="color"> values and preview swatches). This is user data, not the Ashbi theme.

src/components/media/markup.js.reason: Annotation colour palette saved with markup data and drawn onto media; must be stable hex so every viewer sees the stored colour.

src/components/review/markup.js.reason: Review annotation colour palette saved with review data; same reason as media/markup.js.

src/pages/ApprovalQueue.jsx.reason: Categorical content-type chip (COPY, pink) in the TYPE_COLORS map; the chip text states the type.

src/components/Layout.jsx.reason: Brand sidebar exception: the sidebar is a fixed brand-indigo surface in both themes (brand-* colours, white/NN tints). The logout hover uses red-400 because the theme's destructive token is too dark on indigo in light mode.

src/lib/data-colors.js.reason: Single source for colours stored as data (default calendar event / milestone colour).

src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx.reason: console.group %c styling for developer logs; never rendered in the UI.

src/lib/api.js.reason: console.group %c styling for developer API-error logs; never rendered in the UI.

src/components/review/AnnotationOverlay..reason: White halo under annotation shapes so they stay visible on any media; independent of the UI theme.

src/components/review/pdf-render.worker..reason: White page fill for rendered PDF pages in an OffscreenCanvas (a worker has no CSS variables).

src/pages/PortalContract.jsx.reason: Signature-pad ink colour on a canvas, which cannot read Tailwind classes; the signature image is stored.
